configuration.limits: The first MoE layer and this follow-up question were selected after previous diagnostics. The new amplitude intervention is sealed before its outcomes; this is not project-level preregistration. Calibration uses an already sealed four-complete-batch training probe previously used in training and diagnostics, not held-out generalization data. Validation was repeatedly examined and is not an independent test set. Source seed (n=5) is the independent replication unit; tokens, batches, recipient contexts, modes and variants are nested measurements. One training-only scalar per seed/model type changes only global contribution amplitude. Residual differences can include directions, token-specific amplitude allocation, zero support, assignments and gates; they are not an isolated direction effect. Global norms/cosines describe interventions, not why they help. Recipient context includes its own residual and subsequent computation, not downstream weights alone. Native/replay differences include downstream routing responses and do not isolate a routing mechanism. Sparse-minus-unpruned effects compare each trajectory's own intervention and are not equal absolute-amplitude perturbations. No equivalence claim, percentage of recovery explained, expert weight learning, training counterfactual, standalone sparse recoverability, online pruning criterion or generalization beyond this architecture/mask family/window is established. No follow-up is launched.
